```python
     """Return a Greatest Common Divisor of two integers `a` and `b``"""  # Docstring which describes the purpose/functionality of this method in detail, similar to docstrings used on functions or methods  
     
     while b != 0:       # While loop will continue until 'b' becomes zero. This is an Euclidean algorithm for finding GCD   
         a , b = b ,a % b  # The line performs the actual computation of gcd, it replaces both numbers with their remainder and then repeats this process till we get our final result  
     return abs(a)      # Returns absolute value as per requirement. If input is negative number GCD will be positive   
```
